checks: Recognize the library-initiated change as an exception to the normal same-day cancellation rule, then select a concessive rather than exclusive condition. Independent blind solve and item-level English, Traditional Chinese, answer and each distractor verified after language corrections. Post-submission vocabulary and usage notes were independently checked against the unchanged item and canonical schema.

activeQuestion.prompt: The library charges for reservations canceled on the day of a workshop, but there is no charge when the library itself changes the time. Your reservation was moved by the library. You can cancel it without a fee ____ you do so on the day of the workshop.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 工作坊當天取消預約通常要付費，但若是由圖書館自行更改時間，就不收費。圖書館已更改你的預約時間，____你在工作坊當天取消，也不需付費。

options.whyZh: 當天取消並非免付費的必要條件；免收費是因為時間由圖書館更改。
這裡不是說取消一發生就觸發某個新的安排，而是說連平常應收費的時點也適用例外。
此處並不是選擇另一種行動來取代當天取消；當天取消本身就是例外涵蓋的情況。
同日取消通常要付費，但這次是圖書館改期，因此即使當天取消也不收費。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 同日取消通常要付費，但這次是圖書館改期，因此即使當天取消也不收費。

vocabulary.note: 在活動情境中指事先保留的名額，不限於餐廳訂位或住宿訂房。

originalQuestion.prompt: Upon ____ the confirmation email, guests may select their preferred arrival time.
originalQuestion.promptZh: 旅客____確認郵件後，即可選擇偏好的抵達時間。

options.whyZh: upon 後不能直接接限定動詞 receives。
介系詞 upon 後不能直接接動詞原形。
此處需表示主動收到的動名詞，不是過去式。
upon 是介系詞，後接動名詞 receiving。

originalQuestion.explanationZh: upon 是介系詞，後接動名詞 receiving。
